verdict.rationale: Figma has a public pricing page that lists tier features: cross-team publishing, centralized admin tools, unlimited files for a single team, and 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server' as a plan-level feature, which shows some AI/dev gating by tier. Its AI page documents team-shared AI credits on pay-as-you-go or subscription, with admin visibility into allocation. A community comment confirms Dev Mode moved to a separate license, hinting at seat types. Missing for 10: an explicit breakdown of seat types and their prices, named tiers with prices, clear mapping of which AI features (Figma agent, Make) sit in which tier or seat, AI credit amounts and prices, and independent corroboration that pricing is clear before procurement.
